title: Dental PPO Plans Alternate and Billed-Amount Allowance on Prior-Level Corrections
content:
**Allowance clause.** The allowance a Dental PPO Plans line reprocessed after it was paid at the coinsurance of the plan held before an upgrade (a reprocessed prior-level line) is figured on follows the billed procedure, and so decides the patient share:
- a posterior composite filling on a plan with the posterior composite alternate benefit, or a porcelain or ceramic crown (CDT D2740, D2750, D2751, D2752 or D2783) on a molar (teeth 1, 2, 3, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 30, 31 and 32) on a plan with the molar crown alternate benefit, whose billed amount is not below its alternate allowance, is figured on its alternate allowance;
- any line whose billed amount is below the allowance that would otherwise apply (the alternate allowance for such a filling or crown, the allowed amount otherwise) is figured on its billed amount;
- every remaining line is figured on its allowed amount.

**Alternate benefits by plan.** Posterior composite alternate benefit: Preventive 750, Value 1000, Classic 1250 and Plus 1500 (not Premier 2000 or Elite 2500). Molar crown alternate benefit: Classic 1250 and Plus 1500 only.

### Truth table for a filling or crown that qualifies for an alternate benefit (hypothetical amounts: alternate allowance 140.00, allowed 205.00)
| Billed amount | Figured on |
|---|---|
| 140.00 (equal to the alternate allowance) | 140.00, the alternate allowance |
| 139.99 | 139.99, the billed amount |
| 260.00 | 140.00, the alternate allowance |

For any other line (hypothetical allowed amount 205.00): billed 204.99 is figured on 204.99; billed 205.00 or more on 205.00.
